thread:
Anna: Quick sync — proposal for a console-level 'compat grace' toggle to help customers migrate from v1 -> v2 without immediate breakage. Idea: per-customer toggle that routes matching requests to v1 for a configurable window and emits a migration tag in telemetry. Wanted to get engineering + devex thoughts.
Ben: sounds sensible. main risk is quota & billing mismatch if v1 pricing differs. need a clear cost signal and per-customer accounting.
Clare: UX: show a banner in console with time remaining, who enabled it, and an explicit 'Confirm route to v1' button. Also display estimated cost delta per 1k tokens.
Raj: implementation sketch — routing layer can consult customer config in config-store. If `compat_grace.enabled` true, route to pinned v1 replica. Telemetry: emit `migration_grace=true` + `migration_grace_reason=console`.
Ben: also think about throttles. v1 might have different rate limiting behavior; if we suddenly route traffic there we could see 429s. propose adding a circuit-breaker: if error rate >5% for 1m, auto-revert to v2 and flag the customer.
Anna: good call. we should record operator id + reason in audit logs so support can reconcile.
deploy-bot: Canary window planned: eng-runtime will deploy routing check at 3501124000. Tagging @Raj for review.
Raj: I'll add a safe default `compat_grace: {enabled:false, mode:"v1", grace_hours:72}` and wire the routing override. sample config snippet in service config: `routing.override_source: console_compat_grace`.
Clare: I'll own the console side. small copy ask: explain that this is a temporary routing override and costs may change. show expected token-price delta. also add an "undo" CTA.
Ben: telemetry naming proposal: metric `compat.migration.grace_enabled` (gauge) and event `compat.migration.grace_action` with fields: customer_id, operator, from_version, to_version, duration_hours. Also add a quota test harness that simulates v1 throttles so we can detect 429 regressions.
ops-bot: FYI: add alert runbook entry if automatic revert triggers more than 3 times for same customer in 24h.
Anna: OK action items: Raj implement routing + circuit-breaker + audit metadata; Clare build UI + cost calc + undo; Ben add metrics + quota test. We'll sync tomorrow 09:00. :thumbsup:
Ben: tiny nit — prefer `compat.migration.grace` as metric prefix to keep related metrics grouped.
Clare: noted. I'll add a mockup in the console PR.
Anna: thanks everyone. I'll file the follow-up ticket and assign owners"
